name: AppFlowy-Postgres
description: Step 1/7: PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector extension — the primary database for AppFlowy Cloud. Deploy first. Part of the AppFlowy Cloud stack.

paths.name: Data Directory
paths.description: Persistent data directory for PostgreSQL. Must be on a path with enough free space.

ports.name: Postgres Port (internal)
ports.description: PostgreSQL port. Exposed to the appflowy Docker network only. Change host port only if you need external access.

variables.name: Postgres User
variables.description: PostgreSQL superuser username. Must match the value used in all other AppFlowy services.

variables.name: Postgres Password
variables.description: PostgreSQL superuser password. Change this before first start. Must match all other AppFlowy services.

variables.name: PGPORT
variables.description: Port PostgreSQL listens on inside the container. Keep in sync with the port mapping above.
